property_summary: renounceRole can only ever target the caller itself: for any role and any account different from msg.sender the call must revert in the reference, while the mutant (require account != msg.sender) lets it go through and silently revokes (or no-ops) another account's role, so a fuzzed caller/target pair with target != caller distinguishes them.
change_summary: Invert the require condition so renouncing is only allowed for addresses other than the caller.
